steps: Chemistry is a vast subject and it is difficult to study all its aspects together.
Many different kinds of substances and chemical reactions exist, so they need to be studied separately.
Dividing Chemistry into branches makes its study systematic and helps specialists gain detailed knowledge of particular areas.
items.finalAnswer: Chemistry is divided into branches to make the vast subject easier to study systematically and in detail.

steps: Chemical reactions involving electrons outside the nucleus are studied in the branches of Chemistry dealing with chemical changes.
Reactions taking place inside the nucleus are studied in nuclear chemistry.
items.finalAnswer: Chemical reactions are studied in the branches of Chemistry dealing with chemical changes; nuclear reactions are studied in nuclear chemistry.

steps: Analytical chemistry solves problems about the composition of substances.
It identifies the substances or components present (qualitative analysis) and determines their amounts (quantitative analysis).
items.finalAnswer: Analytical chemistry identifies the components of a substance and determines their amounts.

steps: Graphite consists of many layers of carbon atoms arranged in hexagons, one layer above another.
Graphene is a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal pattern; it is one atom thick.
items.finalAnswer: Graphite has many hexagonal carbon layers, whereas graphene is a single hexagonal layer of carbon atoms.

steps: A supercritical fluid is formed above a substance’s critical temperature and critical pressure.
It has properties of both liquids and gases: it can dissolve substances like a liquid and diffuse through materials like a gas.
These properties make supercritical fluids useful as solvents, for example in extracting substances such as caffeine from coffee.
items.finalAnswer: Supercritical fluids are useful solvents because they combine liquid-like dissolving ability with gas-like diffusion.

steps: Matter in the Sun exists in the plasma state.
Graphene is extremely strong and light.
It conducts electricity and heat very well and is flexible.
These properties make it important for applications such as electronic devices, sensors and energy-storage devices.
items.finalAnswer: Graphene is important because it is strong, light, flexible and an excellent conductor of heat and electricity.

steps: Most material things in the world belong to the solid state.
